newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates Costilla Energy senior notes B1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Costilla Energy senior notes B1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it assigned a debt rating of B1 to Costilla Energy Inc.'s $100 million of senior notes.
This was the first time Moody's had rated Costilla's debt, Moody's said in a statement.

The notes are being put in place concurrently with an initial public offering of about $60 million, which will restructure this seven-year-old limited liability company to a corporation. Closings of the notes and stock offerings are contingent upon one another.

Moody's said the rating reflected Costilla's history of small but continuous net losses, its modest reserve and equity base, and the risk that it may make acquisitions that could raise its debt levels.
But Moody's said the rating also took into consideration --
-- the nine- year average life of Costilla's reserves, which mitigates reinvestment risk,
-- the reserves' balance between oil and gas,
-- debt of $3 per barrel-of-oil-equivalent, which was reasonable compared to its reserve base,
-- and moderate finding costs, which had enabled it to post good operating margins.
